title: Huawei Launches Premium Smartwatch in Brazil with Cauã Reymond
seoTitle: Huawei launches premium smartwatch in Brazil with Cauã.
subtitle: New smartwatch arrives September 9 with promotional price and up to 21-day battery life
excerpt: Huawei brought the Watch GT 7 Pro to Brazil, a premium smartwatch with titanium, ceramic, sapphire glass, and a 21-day battery, available on special offer on Sep 9.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Huawei announced the arrival of the HUAWEI WATCH GT 7 Pro smartwatch in Brazil, with a campaign starring Cauã Reymond and a launch offer on September 9.

Cauã Reymond Campaign Marks Debut in Brazilian Market

The actor returns as a brand ambassador after participating in previous versions' campaigns, reinforcing the brand's connection to sports, health, and lifestyle.

Special Launch Offer on Digital Platforms

To celebrate the debut, the watch will be sold on Mercado Livre and Shopee platforms at a promotional price of R$ 1,499, while the regular price will be R$ 2,499.

High-Resistance Design and Materials

The GT 7 Pro features an aerospace-grade titanium alloy structure, a 3D nanocrystalline ceramic bezel, sapphire glass, and a 1.47-inch AMOLED display with up to 3,000 nits of brightness, in addition to IP69 certification and 5 ATM water resistance.

Advanced Training and Navigation Features

With over 100 workout modes, the smartwatch includes offline maps, an XDR inertial navigation algorithm with AI, and the Sunflower system, which improves positioning in areas without GPS signal. For cycling, it displays incline, power in watts, and other metrics; for skiing, there's an indoor mode and access to over 3,000 resort maps.

Health, Battery Life, and Compatibility

The device monitors heart rate, variability, sleep, stress, ECG, and arrhythmias, and offers a Fitness Preparedness Score, which summarizes nocturnal recovery. The battery lasts up to 21 days, with up to 51 hours in Trail Run mode and 44 hours in outdoor Cycling mode. The watch works with Android, iOS, and Huawei smartphones.

With information from Valor Econômico, Canaltech.
